assets.role: Standalone baked Blender scene, source USD, every CPU frame and independent geometry/media checks; no Blender binary.
New CPU/MCP/CLI/scientific, GPU and browser evidence; original/public-copy log hashes with explicit path redactions.
Optional code/project-data sdist; no demo media, downloaded models or Blender. The full public source tree is the documented installation route.
Optional Python 3.12 code wheel and frozen reference; not a standalone model/data installation.

publication_input.role: Verified clean tree for the operator to create a fresh GitHub repository; excludes private history.
publication_input.checksum_record: Detached SHA256SUMS and PUBLISH.json beside the archive; the archive cannot embed its own checksum.
publication_input.hash_scope: Sorted relative path, NUL, file SHA-256, newline; public files except reports/ (to avoid self-reference).

never_upload: private Git history or old Git bundle
local research archives, LAN publication and operator notes
downloaded Blender binaries or unreviewed Docker image archives
